proposal.before: Hong proposed making sixteen palace officers viscounts or barons. Yao Zan objected, “Surely the crown prince’s civil and military officers owe him loyalty as a matter of duty. They have shown no conspicuous merit. Why grant them so many fiefs?”
proposal.after: Hong proposed making sixteen palace officers viscounts or barons under the five-rank system of nobility. Yao Zan objected, “Surely the crown prince’s civil and military officers owe him loyalty as a matter of duty. They have shown no conspicuous merit. Why grant them so many fiefs?”
proposal.reason: 五等 explicitly names the five-grade nobility framework as well as the two ranks 子男; the accepted literal already includes this. This is the only 五等 occurrence in this chapter.

originalUnit.zh: 將封宮臣十六人五等子男，姚贊諫曰：「東宮文武，自當有守忠之誠，未有赫然之效，何受封之多乎？」
originalUnit.en: Yao Zan objected to raising sixteen household officers to noble rank: "The heir's staff owes loyalty by duty—they have done nothing spectacular yet."
originalUnit.literal: He was about to enfeoff sixteen palace officials as fifth-rank barons and viscounts; Yao Zan remonstrated, saying, "Eastern-palace civil and military naturally ought to have the loyalty of guarding unto death—they have not yet had blazing manifest merit; how can they receive so many enfeoffments?"

proposal.before: Before long Jin Grand Commandant Liu Yu commanded the great host to campaign against Hong, halted at Pengcheng, sent General Who Wins the Championship Tan Daoji and General Who Soars like Dragon Wang Zhen'e in from Huai and Fei to attack Qiqiu and Xiangcheng, General Shen Linzi from Bian into the He to attack Cangyuan.
proposal.after: Before long Liu Yu, grand commandant of Jin, led a great army against Hong and halted at Pengcheng. He sent Champion General Tan Daoji and Dragon-Soaring General Wang Zhen'e in by the Huai and Fei rivers to attack Qiqiu and Xiangcheng. General Shen Linzi went from the Bian into the Yellow River to attack Cangyuan.
proposal.reason: 冠軍將軍 is the military rank Champion General. Both fields of the only other occurrence of 冠軍 (s0131), and s0080 idiomatic, already use Champion General. The replacement preserves 劉裕’s command, officers and titles, Shen’s separate route and objectives.

originalUnit.zh: 尋而晉太尉劉裕總大軍伐泓，次於彭城，遣冠軍將軍檀道濟、龍驤將軍王鎮惡入自淮、肥，攻漆丘、項城，將軍沈林子自汴入河，攻倉垣。
originalUnit.en: Soon Liu Yu of Jin massed at Pengcheng and sent Tan Daoji and Wang Zhen'e through Huai-Fei against Qiqiu and Xiangcheng while Shen Linzi struck Cangyuan from Bian.
